integrity: The result is an executable exhaustive finite proof with two independent graph constructions and trace representations. No external or independent validation has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification only for the standard 27-vertex Schläfli graph. The proof includes complete finite enumeration of all supports through size four and the 27 neighborhood traces; cardinality excludes larger supports. General graph families are not claimed. Historical priority is limited to inspected sources.
title: The shattered-support complexes of the Schläfli graph under open and closed neighborhoods
